prokeimenon.ref_key: Blessed are You, O Lord, God of our Fathers

notes: In the refectory we eat food prepared with oil, but no fish. If it is the custom, we are permitted to drink two cups of wine to the Glory of God; and at the evening meal, two cups. (This instruction is given in the Lviv Triodion of 1906).

This, according to the Lenten Triodion of Mother Maria and Metropolitan Kallistos (Ware). The Lviv Triodion of 1906 prescribes 10 troparia: six from the Octoechos and 4 from the Triodion. Since the custom of taking the troparia at the Beatitudes has fallen out of practice in most places, it is prudent to adhere to the minimum, until such time as it is fully restored and appreciated.

The Muscovite Typicon, the Antholody for Worship, and the Triodion of Mother Maria and Metropolitan Kallistos (Ware), all conclude with the kontakion of from the Triodion after the Resurrectional troparion, as if it were [a feastal] one of the Lord; however, our service books prescribe the Theotokion, because the kontakion of the Triodion is penitential, not festal. (This instruction given in Dol'nytsky).

variables.title: SUNDAY III OF THE GREAT FAST: VENERATION OF THE PRECIOUS CROSS

notes: This instruction is given in the Lviv Typicon of 1899, which assumes that Matins will be sung separately from Vespers. If Vigil is served, then the transfer should occur before the beginning of Vespers, as indicated in the Triodion.
The Lviv Typicon of 1899 prescribes 9 stichera - 5 being from the Triodion, however, the Triodion of metropolitan Kallistos provides for only 4 stichera, prescribing a total of 8.

rubric.matins_canon: Res 4, Theotokos 2, Triodion 8. Katavasia of the Theotokos.

variables.title: SUNDAY IV OF THE GREAT FAST: VEN. JOHN OF THE LADDER

vestment_color.citation: Dolnytsky: Gold or green for ascetics

notes: The Lvov Triodion of 1906, as well as that of Mother Maria and Metropolitan Kallistos, prescribe the verse "Arise, O Lord my God...", however, this is already one of the usual verses added on Sunday, and if 9 stichera are to be sung, an additional verse is required. The verse from Psalm 111 has been provided here as an option, but is not specifically prescribed in any book.
The Lvov Triodion prescribes 8 troparia in the tone of the week (Resurrectional, from the Octoechos), and does not mention any from the Triodion.

The Anthology for Worship concludes with the kontakion of the saint (from the Triodion), as if it were [a festal] one of the Lord; however, concerning this, Dol'nytsky mentions that: "our service books prescribe the Theotokion, because the kontakion of the Triodion is penitential, not festal." While the kontakion of St. John is not a penitential one, we can apply the same logic here, using the pattern set forth for a polyeleos or vigil-rank feast. In common Galician practice, the Theotokion is sung in the same tone as the "Glory". Other books prescribe Undaunted patroness... in Tone VI. However, in anticipation of Akathist Saturday, during the season of the Triodion it seems appropriate to use the kontakion of the Theotokos in Tone VIII.
